```{r}
full_data <- full_data %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      pff_sackAllowed      == 1 ~ "sack",
      pff_hitAllowed       == 1 ~ "hit",
      pff_hurryAllowed     == 1 ~ "hurry",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 1 ~ "beaten",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 0 &
        is.na(pff_sackAllowed) &
        is.na(pff_hitAllowed) &
        is.na(pff_hurryAllowed) ~ "won",
      pff_beatenByDefender == 0 &
        pff_sackAllowed == 0 & pff_hitAllowed == 0 & pff_hurryAllowed == 0 ~ "won",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

pass_rusher_positions <- c("DE","DT","OLB","ILB","NT","SS","DB","LB","MLB","FS","CB")


init_play_ratings <- players2 %>%
  transmute(
    nflId            = as.character(nflId),
    displayName,
    officialPosition,
    Defense          = officialPosition %in% pass_rusher_positions,
    Offense          = officialPosition %in% c("C","G","T","TE","FB","WR","RB","QB"),
    Player_Elo       = ifelse(Defense, 800, 1200)
  )

valid_rushers <- init_play_ratings %>%
  filter(Defense) %>%
  pull(nflId)


interactions_pr <- full_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%  
  transmute(
    gameId,
    playId,
    blocker_nflId = as.character(nflId),
    rusher_nflId  = as.character(pff_nflIdBlockedPlayer),
    outcome       = response
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%                        # <<< deduplicate frames!
  filter(rusher_nflId %in% valid_rushers)
penalties_long <- full_data %>%
  select(gameId, playId,
         foulName1, foulNFLId1,
         foulName2, foulNFLId2,
         foulName3, foulNFLId3) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("foul"),
    names_to = c(".value", "penalty_num"),
    names_pattern = "(foulName|foulNFLId)([123])"
  ) %>%
  rename(
    penalty_name = foulName,
    penalty_id   = foulNFLId
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(penalty_id)) %>%
  mutate(penalty_id = as.character(penalty_id))

rusher_penalties <- penalties_long %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId, rusher_nflId = penalty_id) %>%
  arrange(penalty_num) %>%
  summarise(
    rusher_penalty1 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "1"][1],
    rusher_penalty2 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "2"][1],
    rusher_penalty3 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "3"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

blocker_penalties <- penalties_long %>%
  group_by(gameId, playId, blocker_nflId = penalty_id) %>%
  arrange(penalty_num) %>%
  summarise(
    blocker_penalty1 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "1"][1],
    blocker_penalty2 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "2"][1],
    blocker_penalty3 = penalty_name[penalty_num == "3"][1],
    .groups = "drop"
  )

interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  left_join(rusher_penalties,  by = c("gameId", "playId", "rusher_nflId")) %>%
  left_join(blocker_penalties, by = c("gameId", "playId", "blocker_nflId"))

setDT(interactions_pr)

elo_vec <- setNames(init_play_ratings$Player_Elo, init_play_ratings$nflId)
```

```{r}
interactions_pr <- interactions_pr %>%
  mutate(
    rusher_penalty = if_any(starts_with("rusher_penalty"), ~ !is.na(.)),
    blocker_penalty = if_any(starts_with("blocker_penalty"), ~ !is.na(.)),
    response_mod = case_when(
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "sack"   ~ "hit",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "hit"    ~ "hurry",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "hurry"  ~ "beaten",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "beaten" ~ "won",
      rusher_penalty & !blocker_penalty & outcome == "won"    ~ "won",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "won"    ~ "beaten",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "beaten" ~ "hurry",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "hurry"  ~ "hit",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "hit"    ~ "sack",
      blocker_penalty & !rusher_penalty & outcome == "sack"   ~ "sack",
      rusher_penalty & blocker_penalty                        ~ outcome,
      TRUE                                                    ~ outcome
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-rusher_penalty, -blocker_penalty)
```


```{r}
interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr %>%
  group_by(rusher_nflId) %>%
  mutate(rusher_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_nflId) %>%
  mutate(blocker_row = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

adaptive_K_prov <- function(n,
                            K_start = 20,
                            K_min   = 10,
                            n_prov  = 50,
                            n_decay = 100) {
  # for each n, if n <= n_prov → K_min;
  # else if n <= n_decay → linearly ramp down from K_start→K_min;
  # else → K_min
  k <- ifelse(
    n <= n_prov,
    K_min,
    ifelse(
      n <= n_decay,
      K_start + (K_min - K_start) * (n - n_prov) / (n_decay - n_prov),
      K_min
    )
  )
  # just in case the linear formula ever undershoots:
  pmax(k, K_min)
}

# 2) apply to both rushers & blockers
interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1 %>%
  group_by(rusher_nflId) %>%
    mutate(rusher_k  = adaptive_K_prov(rusher_row,
                                      K_start = 20,
                                      K_min   = 10,
                                      n_prov  = 50,
                                      n_decay = 100)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(blocker_nflId) %>%
    mutate(blocker_k = adaptive_K_prov(blocker_row,
                                      K_start = 20,
                                      K_min   = 10,
                                      n_prov  = 50,
                                      n_decay = 100)) %>%
  ungroup()

head(interactions_pr_1)
```

```{r}
setDT(interactions_pr_1)

interactions_pr_1 <- interactions_pr_1[
  order(gameId, playId)             
][
  , .SD[1],                         
  by = .(gameId, playId, blocker_nflId, rusher_nflId)
][
  , row_id := .I                    
]


all_ids <- unique(c(interactions_pr_1$blocker_nflId, interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId))

# Identify which IDs are rushers, blockers, or both
rushers  <- unique(interactions_pr_1$rusher_nflId)
blockers <- unique(interactions_pr_1$blocker_nflId)

# If a player ever rushes, they start at 800; otherwise 1200
elo_vec <- setNames(
  ifelse(all_ids %in% rushers, 800, 1200),
  all_ids
)


get_elo <- function(id) {
  if (!id %in% names(elo_vec)) {
    elo_vec[[id]] <<- 1000               
  }
  elo_vec[[id]]
}

elo_outcome_value <- function(response_mod) {
  case_when(
    response_mod == "won"    ~ 1,
    response_mod == "beaten"  ~ 0.7,
    response_mod == "hurry"    ~ 0.55,
    response_mod == "hit" ~ 0.45,
    response_mod == "sack"   ~ 0
  )
}

elo_step <- function(
  belo, relo, response_mod, blocker_K, rusher_K,
  n_blockers_for_rusher = 1, scale = 400
) {
  outcome <- elo_outcome_value(response_mod)
  if (is.na(outcome)) return(c(b = belo, r = relo))   

  blocker_bonus <- 100 * log2(n_blockers_for_rusher)
  adj_belo <- belo + blocker_bonus

  exp_blk <- 1 / (1 + 10 ^ ((relo - adj_belo) / scale))

  c(
    b = belo + blocker_K * ( outcome      - exp_blk),      
    r = relo + rusher_K * ((1 - outcome) - (1 - exp_blk))
  )
}

elo_history <- interactions_pr_1[
  , .(gameId, playId, row_id,
      blocker_nflId, rusher_nflId, response_mod,
      blocker_k, rusher_k,
      rusher_row, blocker_row,# <- add the adaptive K columns
      before_blocker_elo = NA_real_,
      before_rusher_elo  = NA_real_,
      after_blocker_elo  = NA_real_,
      after_rusher_elo   = NA_real_)
]

for (i in seq_len(nrow(elo_history))) {

  b_id <- elo_history$blocker_nflId[i]
  r_id <- elo_history$rusher_nflId[i]
  out  <- elo_history$response_mod[i]
  b_K  <- elo_history$blocker_k[i]
  r_K  <- elo_history$rusher_k[i]

  b_elo <- get_elo(b_id)
  r_elo <- get_elo(r_id)

  elo_history$before_blocker_elo[i] <- b_elo
  elo_history$before_rusher_elo[i]  <- r_elo

  new <- elo_step(b_elo, r_elo, out, b_K, r_K)

  elo_history$after_blocker_elo[i]  <- new["b"]
  elo_history$after_rusher_elo[i]   <- new["r"]

  elo_vec[b_id] <- new["b"]
  elo_vec[r_id] <- new["r"]
}
```


```{r}
interaction_counts <- rbind(
  interactions_pr_1[ , .(n = .N), by = .(nflId = blocker_nflId)],
  interactions_pr_1[ , .(n = .N), by = .(nflId = rusher_nflId)]
)[

ladder <- data.table(
  nflId     = names(elo_vec),
  final_elo = as.numeric(elo_vec)
)[
  , nflId := as.character(nflId)
][
  players2[ , .(nflId = as.character(nflId),
                displayName,
                officialPosition)],
  on = "nflId"
][
  interaction_counts,
  on = "nflId"
][
  , side_of_ball := fifelse(
        officialPosition %in% c("DE","DT","OLB","ILB","NT",
                                "LB","MLB","FS","SS","CB","DB"),
        "Defense", "Offense")
]

min_reps <- 200

top_rushers <- ladder[
  side_of_ball == "Defense" & n_interactions >= min_reps
][order(-final_elo)][1:10]

top_blockers <- ladder[
  side_of_ball == "Offense" & n_interactions >= min_reps
][order(-final_elo)][1:10]
```

```{r}
  filter(rusher_nflId %in% rusher_ids) %>%
  group_by(rusher_nflId) %>%
  filter(any(rusher_row > 199)) %>%
```

```{r}
            sd_elo   = sd(mean_25, na.rm = TRUE),
            max_elo = max(mean_25, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_elo = min(mean_25, na.rm = TRUE),
            median_elo = median(mean_25, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# 1) make sure response_mod is a factor in the right order
df2 <- df %>% 
  mutate(response_mod = factor(response_mod,
                               levels = c("sack","hit","hurry","beaten","won")))

# 2) pivot only the five prediction columns into long form
per_class_loss <- df2 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(p_sack, p_hit, p_hurry, p_beaten, p_won),
    names_to  = "prob_col",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  # strip off the "p_" to get the class name
  mutate(class = sub("^p_", "", prob_col)) %>%
  # 3) compute –mean(log p) within each class only for the rows whose truth==class
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    class_logloss  = -mean(if_else(response_mod == class,
                                   log(prob),
                                   NA_real_),
                           na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4) compute the single overall log-loss
overall_loss <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    # pick the log‐prob corresponding to the true outcome
    logloss = case_when(
      response_mod == "sack"   ~ -log(p_sack),
      response_mod == "hit"    ~ -log(p_hit),
      response_mod == "hurry"  ~ -log(p_hurry),
      response_mod == "beaten" ~ -log(p_beaten),
      response_mod == "won"    ~ -log(p_won),
      TRUE                     ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  summarise(overall_logloss = mean(logloss, na.rm = TRUE))

# Inspect
per_class_loss
overall_loss
```

```{r}
adaptive_K_logistic <- function(n,
                                K_start = 40,
                                K_min   = 20,
                                n_mid   = 100,
                                steep   = 0.05) { 
  range <- K_start - K_min
  K_min + range / (1 + exp((n - n_mid) * steep))
}

adaptive_K_hyp <- function(n, K_start=40, K_min=20, n_decay=200) {
  # K = K_start / (1 + (n-1)/n_decay), then shift so it bottoms at K_min:
  raw  <- K_start / (1 + (n-1)/n_decay)
  shift <- raw[1] - K_start
  pmax(raw - shift, K_min)
}

adaptive_K <- function(n, K_start = 40, K_min = 20, n_decay = 200) {
  val <- K_min + (K_start - K_min) * exp(-(n - 1) / n_decay)
  pmax(val, K_min)
}

adaptive_K_lin <- function(n, K_start=40, K_min=20, n_decay=200) {
  val <- K_start - (K_start - K_min) * ((n-1) / n_decay)
  pmax(val, K_min)
}

N <- seq(1:200)

y_log <- adaptive_K_logistic(N)
y_lin <- adaptive_K_lin(N)
y_hyp <- adaptive_K_hyp(N)
y_exp <- adaptive_K(N)



plot(y_log)
plot(y_lin)
plot(y_hyp)
plot(y_exp)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(Matrix)

# ---- 1) build a little df with just the columns we need ----
df <- interactions_pr_1 %>%
  select(
    blocker_nflId,
    rusher_nflId,
    n_blockers_for_rusher,
    response_mod
  ) %>%
  mutate(response_mod=factor(response_mod))

# ---- 2) force a common factor level‐set for one‐hots ----
all_ids <- sort(unique(c(df$blocker_nflId, df$rusher_nflId)))
df2 <- df %>%
  mutate(
    blk_f = factor(blocker_nflId, levels = all_ids),
    rus_f = factor(rusher_nflId,  levels = all_ids)
  )

# ---- 3) build sparse one-hot matrices and subtract ----
blk_mat  <- sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + blk_f, df2)
rush_mat <- sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + rus_f, df2)
X_bt     <- blk_mat - rush_mat

# ---- 4) tack on your numeric feature ----
X_bt <- cbind(
  X_bt,
  n_blockers_for_rusher = df2$n_blockers_for_rusher
)

# ---- 5) pull out your response ----
y_bt <- df2$response_mod

# ---- 6) package into a data.frame and fit a logistic model ----
new_data <- data.frame(
  response_mod = y_bt,
  as.matrix(X_bt)    # glm() wants a dense data.frame
)

head(new_data)
```

```{r}
X_rig <- sparse.model.matrix(
  response_mod ~ .,
  data = new_data
)[,-1]
class_levels <- c("sack", "hit", "hurry", "beaten", "won")
y01 <- as.integer(factor(y_bt, levels = class_levels)) - 1
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(doParallel)

lambda_seq <- 10^seq(-4, 0, length.out = 50)

cv_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  X_rig, y01,
  family           = "multinomial",
  alpha            = 0,
  lambda           = lambda_seq,
  nfolds           = 3,
  control          = list(maxit = 1e6)
)

best_lambda <- cv_ridge$lambda.min

fit_ridge <- glmnet(
  X_rig, y01,
  family = "multinomial",
  alpha = 0,
  lambda = best_lambda,
  maxit = 1e6
)
```

```{r}
library(glmnet)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(yardstick)

# assume you already have:
#  • class_levels  = c("sack","hit","hurry","beaten","won")
#  • X_bt          = your sparse model matrix (n × K)
#  • y_bt          = factor vector of length n with those same levels
#  • fit_ridge     = your glmnet fit (family="multinomial")
#  • best_lambda   = the λ you chose (e.g. cv_ridge$lambda.min)

# 1.  predict probabilities at the chosen λ
#    `predict(..., type="response", s=best_lambda)` returns an array n × K × 1
probs_array <- predict(
  fit_ridge,
  newx = X_rig,
  s     = best_lambda,
  type  = "response"
)

# drop the singleton 3rd dimension → n × K matrix
probs_mat <- probs_array[,,1]

# 2.  assemble a tibble for evaluation
df_pred <- tibble(
  truth = factor(y_bt, levels = class_levels)
) %>% 
  bind_cols(as_tibble(probs_mat)) %>% 
  rename_with(~ class_levels, everything()[ -1 ]) 
  # now df_pred has columns: truth, sack, hit, hurry, beaten, won

# 3.  multiclass log‐loss
mlog <- df_pred %>%
  mn_log_loss(
    truth,
    sack, hit, hurry, beaten, won
  )

print(mlog)
```

```{r}

# 1) compute the empirical distribution of non-won outcomes in your training set
freqs <- interactions_pr_1 %>% 
  filter(response_mod != "won") %>% 
  count(response_mod) %>% 
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))
# freqs$response_mod  == c("sack","hit","hurry","beaten")

# 2) start from your BT prediction tibble df_pred:
#    it has columns: truth, sack, hit, hurry, beaten, won
df_bt_adj <- df_pred %>% 
  rename(p_won = won) %>% 
  mutate(
    # leftover probability mass after P(won)
    p_non_won = 1 - p_won,
    # redistribute according to empirical props
    p_sack   = p_non_won * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "sack"],
    p_hit    = p_non_won * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "hit"],
    p_hurry  = p_non_won * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "hurry"],
    p_beaten = p_non_won * freqs$prop[freqs$response_mod == "beaten"]
  ) %>% 
  # now drop the old prob columns and make sure names match the levels exactly
  select(
    truth,
    sack   = p_sack,
    hit    = p_hit,
    hurry  = p_hurry,
    beaten = p_beaten,
    won    = p_won
  )

# 3) compute the multinomial log‐loss
bt_mm_logloss_empirical <- df_bt_adj %>% 
  mn_log_loss(
    truth,   # your true factor, must have levels c("sack","hit","hurry","beaten","won")
    sack,    # unquoted names matching those levels
    hit,
    hurry,
    beaten,
    won
  )

bt_mm_logloss_empirical
```
